# Jackson House

> Jackson House is an elevated restaurant and craft cocktail bar in Woodinville, WA serving seasonal small plates, curated spirits, and memorable hospitality.

Hours: Wed-Thu 5pm-10pm; Fri 4pm-10pm; Sat-Sun 2pm-10pm
Happy Hour: Wed-Thur 5pm-6pm; Fri: 4pm-6pm; Sat-Sun 2pm-4pm
Address: 17409 133rd Ave NE #1203, Woodinville, WA 98072
Phone: (425) 364-4544
Email: info@jacksonhousewoodinville.com

## About
Jackson House is a beautifully appointed dining room and whiskey-driven bar and lounge. We celebrate the best of the Pacific Northwest through intricately crafted cocktails, seasonally driven cuisine, and warm hospitality.
Our Dining Room offers a full-service restaurant experience with locally inspired, chef-driven artisanal plates designed to be shared (or not).
Our Bar & Lounge features a relaxed, small-bite-focused, self-service format, with approachable team members ensuring a smooth experience. Join us midweek for gathering nights, including Vinyl Night on Thursdays. Visit on Wednesdays for Mystery Flight Night (guess all three pours correctly for a bonus pour) and half-price bottled wine.
Reservations are available in the dining room, or stop by and enjoy our lounge experience without a reservation.

- [Private events](https://www.jacksonhousewoodinville.com/private-events.html)
- Private Gatherings: Birthdays, business dinners, and social gatherings that want a private touch within regular service hours.
- Curated Gatherings: Chef-driven, elevated formats designed for memorable evenings - from refined multi-course dinners to lively social experiences.

## Membership
- [Membership](https://www.jacksonhousewoodinville.com/membership.html)
- Top Shelf Club ($250 quarterly): Curated tastings and elevated experiences; Rare and local spirits; 5% food discounts; Priority access to reservations and ticketed events
- Cocktail Club ($100 quarterly): Perks and previews for regulars; Craft cocktails and seasonal menus; Exclusive cocktail menu access; Priority access to reservations and ticketed events
